description: Estimate at prompt submission, surface failures, and calibrate after each turn without storing prompt or tool content.

hooks.command: node -e "const p=require('node:path'),u=require('node:url'),r=process.env.CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!r)throw new Error('Agent ETA plugin root is unavailable');import(u.pathToFileURL(p.join(r,'scripts','hook-launcher.mjs')).href).then(m=>m.runHookLauncherProcess()).catch(()=>{process.stderr.write('Agent ETA hook launcher failed\\n');process.exitCode=1})"
